newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow city to issue Eurobond by Feb 1997.
newsitem.headline: Moscow city to issue Eurobond by Feb 1997.

text.p: The City of Moscow plans to issue a first $500 million Eurobond by February of next year, a spokesman for the city administration said on Wednesday.
"Now we are doing technical work in two directions. We are getting the issue registered at the Finance Ministry and getting a credit rating," spokesman Mikhail Chernyshov told Reuters.
He said he expected Moscow's credit rating to be about the same as the sovereign one.
In October Russia received a better-than-expected credit rating for its debut Eurobond, which classified the paper as just under investment grade.
A $1 billion debut Eurobond for Russia last month was heavily oversubscribed.
Moscow has chosen CS First Boston and Nomura International as lead managers for the project.
